name: io.ingilizce/vocabulary-video-tutor
title: ingilizce.io – English Vocabulary Video Tutor
description: Bilingual TR/EN CEFR A1–C1 English vocabulary video lessons, examples, quizzes, Daily 5 Stars.

tools.name: get_word_lesson
tools.description: Fetch the complete bilingual (Turkish & English) vocabulary video lesson for an English word on ingilizce.io, including CEFR level (A1–C1), Archipelago, Assistant Captain, 3 meanings, example sentences, common collocations, usage note, and clickable YouTube & ingilizce.io lesson URLs.

word.description: English word to look up (e.g. "abandon", "culture", "ice cream").

lang.description: Return Turkish ("tr"), English ("en"), or both ("both") lesson sections.

tools.name: search_vocabulary
tools.description: Search published ingilizce.io vocabulary videos by English word, Turkish meaning keyword (e.g. "tüketici", "yetenek"), English meaning keyword, CEFR level (A1–C1), or Assistant Captain name (Emma, Vela, Victoria, Lupus, Nova, Atlas, Lyra, Orion, Grace, Sirius).

query.description: Search text (English word, Turkish meaning, or topic). Optional if filtering by level/captain.

tools.name: get_level_words
tools.description: Retrieve published English vocabulary words and video links for a specific CEFR level (A1, A2, B1, B2, or C1) on ingilizce.io.

tools.name: get_daily_5_stars
tools.description: Fetch a Daily 5 Stars (Günlük 5 Yıldız) compilation episode containing 5 words (one from each CEFR level A1–C1) and its YouTube video link. Defaults to the latest published episode.

day.description: Episode number (omit to get the latest published episode).

tools.name: build_word_quiz
tools.description: Generate a grounded 3-question interactive vocabulary quiz for a published ingilizce.io word using its real 3 meanings and example sentences.

word.description: English word to build a quiz for (e.g. "abandon").
